name: TB-500

effects: 43-amino acid actin-sequestering peptide — promotes cell migration and tissue repair
Reduces inflammation and fibrosis in cardiac and skeletal muscle (animal models)
Promotes angiogenesis and neuronal regeneration in preclinical studies
Popular in athletic recovery for soft-tissue injuries — no human RCT evidence
Typically dosed 2–5 mg twice weekly for loading phase, then once weekly maintenance
Not FDA approved for human use; classified as banned in competitive sport (WADA)
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
